reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.2 (agents), on all 69 tee, green and bunker rings on four photo years, the greens also on the contrast-stretched photo, with the registered guide plates and the deck check

accepted.tjusta-green-10: drawn by hand: the rim shows round the north end and down the north-west side on every photo year, the front is set where the 2021 leaf-off photo turns from green to dormant turf and the 2023 mowing pattern changes (uncertain by some 3 m), and the east side lies under the wood's shadow on all four years. A stated fault of the ground until someone stands on it
accepted.tjusta-tee-01-1: the laser's level platform under the OSM tee way; its mown deck at the north end is where the plate puts the yellow tee (0.1 m off). The ring takes in grass round the deck
accepted.tjusta-tee-02-1: level deck north of Kimstavägen with a striped box on it; the plate puts the yellow tee 1 m from its centre
accepted.tjusta-tee-02-2: a mown oval with markers on both photos; the edge is soft against the fairway
accepted.tjusta-tee-06-1: one deck for both tees (the card 127 and 121), level in the laser, by the yard: the mown rectangle (bare and reseeded on the May 2023 photo) and the round patch north-west of it on the same platform; the plate's tee is 1 m from it
accepted.tjusta-tee-10-1: the level patch in the clearing south of the row house, under crowns; the plate's yellow tee is 13 m east, in the same clearing
accepted.tjusta-tee-10-2: drawn on the photo: the round mown platform with a tee rectangle the plate's line passes; not level in the laser (6%), kept as drawn
accepted.tjusta-tee-11-1: a level deck under crowns at the head of the strip; the plate's yellow tee is 4 m off
accepted.tjusta-tee-12-2: a small level deck in shade; the plate draws a forward tee 4 m from it
accepted.tjusta-tee-14-1: a striped rectangular deck by the path, clear on both photos; the edge score is low only because the deck is mown like the field round it
accepted.tjusta-tee-16-1: a level deck under crowns at the foot of the middle corridor; the plate's yellow tee is 0.4 m from its centre
accepted.tjusta-tee-16-2: a mown deck visible on both photos, kept as the laser's platform

tjusta-tee-01-1.reason: A long boot-shaped ring on open grass whose upper arm runs up toward the car park; the only deck-like patch is a small pale square in its lower lobe, and a dark tree or object sits on its right edge in both years.
tjusta-tee-01-1.resolution: one level platform in the laser under OSM's tee way, 20 m long, narrowed at a tree; its mown rectangle at the south-west end is where the plate puts the yellow tee (0.1 m off) and the card length agrees within a metre. The north-east lobe is the same platform, mown as tee on the 2019 photo

tjusta-tee-04-4.reason: Years disagree: in summer the ring holds a pale square deck in its upper part, but in the leaf-off photo a dark oval (a crown, its shadow or standing water) fills the lower half of the ring, and the ring is rounder and larger than the square deck.
tjusta-tee-04-4.resolution: a level platform in the laser beside the 4th hole's decks, uncoloured; the pale square on the 2025 photo is its tee box, and the dark oval over its lower half on the April 2021 photo is the shade of the trees south of it, as on the other decks there that year

tjusta-tee-06-1.reason: The ring is two lobes joined by a narrow neck along the road bank, so it takes in two separate patches (a pale deck at its lower right and a second area at its upper left) rather than one deck.
tjusta-tee-06-1.resolution: one level platform for both tees (the card gives 127 and 121 m): the mown rectangle, bare and reseeded on the May 2023 photo, and the round patch north-west of it, a paler mown round on the July 2019 photo. The plate's tee is 1 m from it

tjusta-tee-08-1.reason: An angular pentagon with straight cut edges on open turf, its top edge shared with three neighbouring lines; neither photo shows a deck edge that the line follows.
tjusta-tee-08-1.resolution: the lower part of one L-shaped mown deck, bright and sharp-edged on the 2025 and 2019 photos with their contrast stretched; the ring follows its mown edge on three sides, and the straight north edge is the division from the 15th hole's arm of the same deck. At sheet scale the deck's edge does not show

tjusta-tee-09-2.reason: An irregular kidney-shaped ring on open mown turf; neither photo shows a deck edge that the line follows.
tjusta-tee-09-2.resolution: the laser's level platform on evenly mown ground: no photo year shows an edge, as the reviewer says, and none is claimed. The card's red length agrees within a metre

tjusta-tee-11-1.reason: A narrow boot-shaped ring lying on tree crowns in summer and in long tree shadow in the leaf-off photo; no deck shows in either.
tjusta-tee-11-1.resolution: a level deck in the laser under crowns at the head of the strip; no photo shows it, and the plate's yellow tee is 4 m off it

tjusta-tee-12-2.reason: A lumpy ring under crowns and shadow in summer and on plain turf in the leaf-off photo, with no deck showing in either; a pale patch lies just below it in the leaf-off photo.
tjusta-tee-12-2.resolution: a small level deck in the laser under the wood's edge; no photo year shows it, as the reviewer says. The plate draws a forward tee 4 m from it and the card's red length agrees within a metre

tjusta-tee-16-1.reason: A large lumpy ring reaching down over rough and tree shadow; the only deck-like patch is a pale rectangle at its top, and the leaf-off photo shows only tree shadow inside it.
tjusta-tee-16-1.resolution: a level platform 12 m by 18 in the laser, under crowns on every photo year, so the laser is its only witness; the pale rectangle at its north end is the tee box, and the plate's yellow tee is 0.4 m from the platform's centre

tjusta-tee-18-3.reason: The ring holds a smooth, very pale oval that looks like a putting or practice green, not a tee deck, while a rectangular tee deck shows just above and to the right, outside the ring, in both photos.
tjusta-tee-18-3.resolution: a level oval platform in the laser between the 17th green and the yellow tee, mown short on all four photo years. On the May 2023 photo it does not stand out from the mown ground round it, as every putting surface does that month, so it is a teeing ground and not a green; the card gives it no colour, and it carries no tee mark

tjusta-bunker-07-1.reason: Years disagree: the summer photo shows a round tan sand pit that the line follows, but the leaf-off photo shows pale grass or bare ground with only a faint circular trace and no sand.
tjusta-bunker-07-1.fault: built after the laser was flown (turf on the April 2021 photo, sand in 2025): the terrain has no bowl under it and it is drawn as flat sand. A newer laser flight puts it right

tjusta-bunker-07-2.reason: Years disagree: the summer photo shows sand that the line follows, but the leaf-off photo shows grass beside a dark ditch and no sand.
tjusta-bunker-07-2.fault: built after the laser was flown (turf on the April 2021 photo, sand in 2025): flat sand on the old ground. A newer laser flight puts it right

tjusta-bunker-11-1.reason: Years disagree: the summer photo shows sand that the line follows, but the leaf-off photo shows green scrub or rough and no sand.
tjusta-bunker-11-1.fault: built after the laser was flown (rough on the April 2021 photo, sand in 2025): flat sand on the old ground. A newer laser flight puts it right

tjusta-bunker-13-1.reason: Years disagree: the summer photo shows a round sand pit that the line follows, but the leaf-off photo shows turf and no sand.
tjusta-bunker-13-1.fault: built after the laser was flown (rough on the April 2021 photo, sand in 2025): flat sand on the old ground. A newer laser flight puts it right

tjusta-bunker-13-2.reason: Years disagree: the summer photo shows sand that the line follows, but the leaf-off photo shows rough grass and no sand.
tjusta-bunker-13-2.fault: built after the laser was flown (rough on the April 2021 photo, sand in 2025): flat sand on the old ground. A newer laser flight puts it right

tjusta-bunker-16-1.reason: Years disagree: the summer photo shows peanut-shaped sand that the line follows, but the leaf-off photo shows pale turf and no sand.
tjusta-bunker-16-1.fault: built after the laser was flown (turf on the April 2021 photo, sand in 2025): flat sand on the old ground. A newer laser flight puts it right

cannotTell.tjusta-tee-04-2: A small round ring on open turf with no deck edge visible in summer, and the leaf-off photo is in deep tree shadow there apart from a pale spot in the middle.
cannotTell.tjusta-tee-07-1: The ring follows a long mown strip that runs on past its top in the leaf-off photo, and its lower third is in tree shadow in summer, so I cannot see whether it is one long deck or a deck (the pale square in its middle) plus the strip.
cannotTell.tjusta-tee-09-1: Crowns and their shadows cover the upper half of the ring in summer, and the leaf-off photo shows a pale clearing in shadow with no deck edge.
cannotTell.tjusta-tee-10-1: The leaf-off photo is in tree shadow, and in summer the pale square deck may sit up and to the left of the ring's centre, but at this scale I cannot place the line against it.
